items.prompt: Name two ways humans can harm the environment.
items.answer: Pollution and habitat destruction (also overusing resources)

steps: Human activities can damage the environment.

items.prompt: What does it mean to monitor a human impact?
items.answer: To measure the impact, often over time

steps: Monitoring tracks the size of an impact.

items.prompt: What does it mean to minimize a human impact?
Give one way to monitor water pollution.
items.answer: Test the water quality regularly and compare results

items.prompt: Give one way to minimize air pollution from cars.
items.answer: Use cleaner energy, electric vehicles, or public transit

items.prompt: Why should a plan to reduce an impact be based on evidence?
items.answer: So you can measure before and after to see if the change helped

steps: Evidence shows whether the solution worked.

items.prompt: Name one method to minimize waste.

steps: Recycling reduces waste sent to landfills.

items.prompt: How could a city check if a new rule reduced pollution?
items.answer: Measure the pollution before and after the rule and compare

steps: Measuring both times shows the effect.

items.answer: To reduce the harm of habitat destruction and preserve species

steps: Protecting habitat minimizes impact on living things.

items.prompt: What are the basic steps of an evidence-based solution?
items.answer: Measure the impact, make a change, then measure again to check it
